svg.title: Crash series: killed while saving
svg.desc: One recorded crash series on the author's Linux machine (ext4, 2026-09-29): in each of 200 trials a collection growing to 24 snapshots was killed with SIGKILL at a random moment within 344 ms. 2,683 snapshots were acknowledged before the kills; 0 were lost and 0 were partial, and 200 of 200 trials resumed to the uninterrupted result. 153 kills came in the middle of a publication. A process kill, not a power cut: power-loss durability is not established.
svg.text: kill time, ms after the writer started
